nodes.label: main
nodes.desc: Parses the contour CLI and dispatches subcommands such as serve and bootstrap.

nodes.label: Server.doServe
nodes.desc: Assembles informers, the DAG builder, resource caches, and the xDS gRPC server.

nodes.label: WriteBootstrap
nodes.desc: Generates Envoy's static bootstrap config that points back to the xDS cluster.

nodes.label: loadBalancerStatusWriter
nodes.desc: Watches the Envoy Service and writes its addresses into Ingress and Gateway status.

nodes.label: EventRecorder
nodes.desc: Counts Kubernetes events per operation before passing them downstream.

nodes.label: EventHandler
nodes.desc: Debounces informer events with a holdoff timer before rebuilding the DAG.

nodes.label: KubernetesCache
nodes.desc: In-memory index of watched Services, Ingresses, HTTPProxies, and Secrets.

nodes.label: Builder
nodes.desc: Runs the ordered Processor chain over the cache and prunes invalid virtual hosts.

nodes.label: HTTPProxyProcessor
nodes.desc: Turns HTTPProxy CRDs into virtual hosts, routes, and clusters.

nodes.label: IngressProcessor
nodes.desc: Translates core Ingress objects into DAG routes.

nodes.label: GatewayAPIProcessor
nodes.desc: Translates Gateway API resources into DAG listeners and routes.

nodes.label: ListenerProcessor
nodes.desc: Adds the fixed HTTP and HTTPS listeners for every distinct virtual host.

nodes.label: DAG
nodes.desc: Routing model of listeners, virtual hosts, routes, clusters, and a status cache.

nodes.label: Route
nodes.desc: Match conditions plus weighted clusters for one path or host rule.

nodes.label: VirtualHost
nodes.desc: Groups routes under a hostname; SecureVirtualHost adds TLS policy.

nodes.label: Cluster
nodes.desc: Upstream endpoint pool with load balancing, health checks, and TLS settings.

nodes.label: Secret
nodes.desc: Resolved TLS certificate chain and key backing a secure virtual host.

nodes.label: HTTPProxy
nodes.desc: Contour's CRD type combining routing rules with virtual host policy.

nodes.label: HTTPProxySpec
nodes.desc: Holds virtualhost, routes, tcpproxy, includes, and ingressClassName.

nodes.label: LoadBalancerPolicy
nodes.desc: Strategy plus request hash policies driving per-request load balancing.

nodes.label: SnapshotHandler
nodes.desc: Packages resource caches into go-control-plane snapshots; muxes EDS via a LinearCache.

nodes.label: ListenerCache
nodes.desc: Builds Envoy Listeners with access logging, TLS, and socket options.

nodes.label: RouteCache
nodes.desc: Converts DAG listeners into Envoy RouteConfigurations.

nodes.label: ClusterCache
nodes.desc: Converts DAG ServiceClusters into Envoy Clusters.

nodes.label: SecretCache
nodes.desc: Publishes TLS certificate and key material as Envoy Secrets.

nodes.label: RuntimeCache
nodes.desc: Exposes tunable runtime settings to Envoy's RTDS layer.

nodes.label: EndpointSliceTranslator
nodes.desc: Turns EndpointSlice updates into ClusterLoadAssignments bypassing the DAG.

nodes.label: NewServer
nodes.desc: Creates the gRPC server with keepalive and TLS options for xDS streams.

nodes.label: v3 Server
nodes.desc: Implements LDS, RDS, CDS, EDS, SDS, RTDS, and ADS gRPC services.

nodes.label: NewRequestLoggingCallbacks
nodes.desc: Hooks the go-control-plane server to log stream and request activity.

nodes.label: ConstantHash
nodes.desc: Hashes every Envoy node to a constant ID so all share one snapshot.

nodes.label: Metrics
nodes.desc: Prometheus gauges and counters for proxies, DAG rebuilds, and status updates.

nodes.label: RebuildMetricsObserver
nodes.desc: Counts valid, invalid, and orphaned HTTPProxies after each DAG rebuild.

nodes.label: status.Cache
nodes.desc: Collects condition updates destined for HTTPProxy status subresources.
